tools.description: Run server garbage collection to purge expired, delivered, or orphaned artifacts and temp files.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare diagnostics, predictive metrics, and lineage across multiple fitted MMMs.

model_ids.description: List of model IDs to compare
model_ids.title: Model Ids

tools.name: cross_validate_mmm
tools.description: Run rolling Time-Slice Cross-Validation with PyMC-Marketing. Evaluates out-of-sample predictive RMSE/NRMSE across multiple temporal folds.

tools.name: diagnose_mmm
tools.description: Mandatory diagnostic gate. Checks sampler health plus posterior predictive coverage, predictive error, and residual behavior before decision tools may run.

tools.name: estimate_customer_lifetime_value
tools.description: Estimate discounted net present Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) by combining a fitted purchase model (e.g. BG/NBD) and monetary value model (e.g. Gamma-Gamma).

value_model_id.description: Fitted monetary value model ID (e.g. Gamma-Gamma)
value_model_id.title: Value Model Id

future_t.title: Future T

top_n.description: Return top N customers by predicted CLV
top_n.title: Top N

tools.name: evaluate_prior_sensitivity
tools.description: Evaluate sensitivity of commercial conclusions (channel rank order and iROAS) under alternative adstock and saturation priors.

model_id.description: Model ID to evaluate for prior sensitivity
model_id.title: Model Id

tools.name: export_artifact_to_sandbox
tools.description: Push/stage a model or dataset artifact (up to 1GB) for the AI client sandbox to download, providing streaming URLs, curl commands, python snippets, and SHA256 integrity checksums.

tools.name: fit_clv_model
tools.description: Fit a Bayesian Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) model on RFM transaction data. (Deprecated: prefer fit_purchase_model or fit_value_model).

recency_column.description: Column with recency (time since last purchase)
recency_column.title: Recency Column

T_column.description: Column with total observation period length

monetary_value_column.description: Column with average monetary value per purchase (required for gamma_gamma)

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

tools.name: fit_mmm
tools.description: Fit a real Bayesian Marketing Mix Model with PyMC-Marketing using typed, controlled configuration. No arbitrary Python is accepted. Supports adstock types: geometric (default), delayed, weibull_cdf, weibull_pdf, binomial, none. Supports saturation types: logistic (default), tanh, tanh_baselined, michaelis_menten, hill, hill_sigmoid, inverse_scaled_logistic, log, root, none. Per-channel adstock/saturation overrides can be set via channel_priors.

normalize.description: Whether to normalize adstock weights to sum to 1
normalize.title: Normalize

ChannelPriorConfig.description: Per-channel prior parameters and/or transform class selection.
ChannelPriorConfig.title: ChannelPriorConfig

adstock.description: Global adstock configuration (default for all channels)

saturation.description: Global saturation configuration (default for all channels)

channel_priors.description: Per-channel adstock and/or saturation overrides. Keys must be a subset of channel_columns. Channels not listed use the global adstock/saturation config.
channel_priors.title: Channel Priors

dist.description: Prior distribution family (e.g. Beta, Gamma, HalfNormal, Normal)
dist.title: Dist

kwargs.description: Distribution parameters (e.g. alpha, beta, sigma, mu)
kwargs.title: Kwargs

tools.name: fit_purchase_model
tools.description: Fit a Bayesian purchase/transaction frequency model (BG/NBD or Shifted Beta-Geometric). Normalizes user column names to canonical RFM attributes.

dataset_id.description: Registered dataset ID containing RFM data
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

recency_col.description: Column with recency (time since last purchase)
recency_col.title: Recency Col

T_col.description: Column with total observation period length
T_col.title: T Col

cohort_col.description: Column with customer cohort (required for sBG)
cohort_col.title: Cohort Col

tools.name: fit_value_model
tools.description: Fit a Bayesian monetary value transaction model (Gamma-Gamma) on repeat customer spending. Requires frequency and average monetary value columns.

dataset_id.description: Registered dataset ID containing monetary transaction data
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

monetary_value_col.description: Column with average monetary value per transaction
monetary_value_col.title: Monetary Value Col

tools.name: get_agent_insights
tools.description: Retrieve previously recorded agent insights, hypotheses, diagnostic notes, or decisions, filter by model, dataset, category, or tag.

tools.name: get_channel_contributions
tools.description: Return posterior channel contribution summaries from the fitted PyMC-Marketing model. Does not fabricate estimates.

tools.name: get_churn_risk_cohorts
tools.description: Identify customers at churn risk from a fitted CLV model. Returns customers whose Bayesian P(alive) is below the specified threshold. Lower threshold = higher confidence of churn. Default threshold: 0.3.

tools.name: get_incremental_roas
tools.description: Return total and marginal iROAS from PyMC-Marketing's official incrementality API, including posterior uncertainty. No ad-hoc LLM ROAS calculation.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Retrieve the execution status, results, or error details of an asynchronous job.

tools.name: get_model_status
tools.description: Get persisted model fit state, lineage, and safe failure information.

tools.name: get_posterior_plots
tools.description: Generate posterior visualization plots from a fitted and approved MMM. Returns base64-encoded PNG/SVG images in the evidence envelope and caches them as MCP resources at marketing://models/{model_id}/plots/{plot_type}. Supported plot types: saturation_curves, waterfall_decomposition, actual_vs_predicted, channel_contribution_share.

tools.name: get_response_curves
tools.description: Return response/saturation information sampled by PyMC-Marketing rather than raw posterior arrays.

tools.name: get_skill_guidance
tools.description: Start here. Route a marketing-science task to one workflow skill and receive its full operating guidance inline (tool order, argument templates, gates, error recovery, and marketing interpretation). Pass task for routing, skill_name to fetch a named skill, or reference_name to fetch a shared reference such as 'agent-operating-protocol' or 'marketing-decision-playbook' when the client cannot read MCP resources.

tools.name: get_skill_workflow_map
tools.description: Retrieve the dependency graph, prerequisites, decision gates, and continuations for all scientific skills.

tools.name: inspect_dataset
tools.description: Inspect a registered dataset before MMM configuration. Returns candidate targets, channels, controls, frequency, and data issues.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent asynchronous background jobs for the active tenant.

tools.name: optimize_budget
tools.description: Use PyMC-Marketing budget optimization under channel or dimension-cell constraints, then compare baseline and recommended posterior responses. Requires a diagnosed model.

planning_periods.description: Number of future periods in planning horizon
planning_periods.title: Planning Periods

tools.name: optimize_flighting
tools.description: Optimize a dynamic weekly media flighting schedule over a planning horizon, accounting for adstock carryover dynamics, channel spend constraints, target iROAS floors, and profit-maximization objectives. The model must be approved or approved_with_caution before optimization. Returns a week-by-week spend table per channel, posterior response distribution, and net-profit estimates.
